program.name: privacyPoolProgram
docs: A programmable, tiered-disclosure privacy pool built with pina.
Combines Helius Solana Privacy Rings' production architecture with Pina's
governed, publicly-logged disclosure state machine — all inside one
`no_std` crate with no `unsafe` code outside `syscalls.rs` and zero
required off-chain infrastructure:
- **Per-nullifier PDAs ([`NullifierRecord`])** — $O(1)$ double-spend
detection, unbounded spend capacity, and zero shared nullifier write-lock
contention. Dummy inputs (`nullifier == [0; 32]`) skip PDA creation.
- **Depth-16 frontier Merkle tree ([`MerkleTree`])** — holds 65,536 leaves
in a 512-byte frontier plus a 32-root ring using compile-time
[`ZERO_HASHES`], eliminating runtime zero-hash recomputation on
initialization.
- **Variable-amount 2-in-2-out join-split circuit** — one unified Groth16
circuit (`VK_SLOT_JOIN_SPLIT`) handles arbitrary-amount withdrawals,
change outputs, UTXO splits, and UTXO merges with 64-bit range checks and
single-input `statement_hash` compression (one `g1_mul` + `g1_add`).
- **SPL Token & Token-2022 escrows ([`AssetVault`])** — permissionless
per-mint asset registration, variable-amount token deposits, and
join-split token withdrawals.
- **128-byte compressed Groth16 proofs** — decompressed on-chain via
`sol_alt_bn128_compression` before the four-pairing check.
- **Relayer & fee-payer decoupling** — optional relayer address and fee
bound into the Groth16 statement so users can pay fees out of shielded
balances without leaking a public fee payer.
- **Real shielded keypair & X25519 + AEAD (`shielded` module)** — host-side
RFC 7748 X25519 viewing keys, per-transaction viewing keys for selective
disclosure, and 2-of-3 GF(256) Shamir custodian shares.
- **Rent-free note emission & privacy-preserving [`DisclosureLog`]** —
encrypted note envelopes and shares emit via [`NoteEncryptedEvent`] with
zero per-note PDA rent; [`RequestDisclosureIx`] authenticates
`view_pubkey` via Merkle membership; [`DisclosureLog`] stores a salted
`scope_hash` rather than raw commitments; verifying keys support authority
rotation.
- **Custom Ring policy & composable CPI** — configurable pause and
co-signer / CPI authority gates ([`SetPolicyIx`]) plus composable ZK
policy verification ([`VerifyPolicyIx`] on [`VK_SLOT_POLICY`]).

accounts.name: poolConfig
docs: Global pool configuration, governance root, and Custom Ring policy flags.

fields.name: authority
docs: Governance key that rotates custodians, requesters, verifying keys, and
Custom Ring policy settings.

fields.name: custodianThreshold
docs: Custodian approvals required to execute a disclosure.

fields.name: challengeWindowSecs
docs: Tier-1 challenge window length in seconds.

fields.name: policyFlags
docs: Custom Ring policy bitmask (`POLICY_PAUSED`, `POLICY_REQUIRE_COSIGNER`).

fields.name: policyCosigner
docs: Required co-signer or Custom Ring program PDA when
`POLICY_REQUIRE_COSIGNER` is active.

fields.name: totalDeposits
docs: Lifetime deposit count, for analysis only.

accounts.name: poolVault
docs: The pool's native SOL custody PDA.

accounts.name: merkleTree
docs: Depth-16 frontier incremental Merkle tree over Poseidon-2 hashes.
Holds up to 65,536 leaves in 512 bytes of `filled_subtrees` plus a 32-root
ring, avoiding the 8 KB full-node layout and runtime zero-hash prefill.

fields.name: nextLeafIndex
docs: Number of leaves written so far.

fields.name: filledSubtrees
docs: Frontier of rightmost filled subtrees, one 32-byte hash per level.

fields.name: rootsLen
docs: Roots currently in the ring; evictions hold it at capacity.

fields.name: roots
docs: Ring of 32 recent roots, oldest first.

accounts.name: nullifierRecord
docs: Per-nullifier spent marker PDA. Existence proves the nullifier was spent in
$O(1)$ without a global nullifier write-lock hotspot or fixed capacity cap.

accounts.name: custodianRegistry
docs: The disclosure committee.

fields.name: custodians
docs: Committee members as concatenated 32-byte addresses.

accounts.name: requesterRegistry
docs: Entities allowed to file tier-1 and tier-2 disclosure requests.

accounts.name: assetVault
docs: Per-mint SPL Token / Token-2022 escrow metadata (mirroring SPR's SPL
Interface PDA).

accounts.name: disclosureRequest
docs: One disclosure request and its state machine. Stores `view_pubkey` after
`RequestDisclosure` authenticates it against the Merkle tree so
`GrantDisclosure` and `ChallengeDisclosure` require no per-note PDA.

accounts.name: disclosureLog
docs: Append-only public record of executed disclosures. Stores a salted
`scope_hash` rather than raw note commitments so observers cannot link log
entries back to shielded notes.

accounts.name: verifyingKeyAccount
docs: Single-input Groth16 verifying key. Every circuit compresses its statement
into one BN254 scalar (`statement_hash`), so only `ic0` and `ic1` are
stored (saving 128 bytes per key and 2+ `g1_mul` syscalls per spend).

arguments.name: custodians
docs: Initial three-member disclosure committee as concatenated 32-byte keys.

arguments.name: slot
docs: Circuit slot: [`VK_SLOT_JOIN_SPLIT`] or [`VK_SLOT_POLICY`].

arguments.name: amount
docs: Variable SOL deposit amount in lamports.

arguments.name: commitment
docs: Client-computed Poseidon note commitment.

arguments.name: viewPubkey
docs: Per-note consent/notification public key.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Relayer / transaction fee payer; receives `relayer_fee` directly.

arguments.name: publicOut
docs: SOL withdrawn to `recipient` in lamports.

arguments.name: relayerFee
docs: Optional fee paid from shielded balance to `relayer`.

arguments.name: changeCommitment
docs: Optional change output commitment (`[0; 32]` if no change).

arguments.name: proofA
docs: 192-byte compressed Groth16 proof (`A: 32B, B: 128B, C: 32B`).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Relayer / transaction fee payer; receives `relayer_fee` directly.

arguments.name: relayerFee
docs: Optional SOL relayer fee deducted from shielded inputs.

arguments.name: proofA
docs: 192-byte compressed Groth16 proof (`A: 32B, B: 128B, C: 32B`).

arguments.name: viewPubkey
docs: Claimed consent key for `commitment`, authenticated via `path_elements`.

arguments.name: policyHash
docs: Single BN254 scalar representing the Custom Ring policy statement.

arguments.name: proofA
docs: 192-byte compressed Groth16 policy proof (`A: 32B, B: 128B, C: 32B`).

events.name: noteEncryptedEvent
docs: Rent-free encrypted note emission. Clients and indexers reconstruct the
Merkle tree and decrypt incoming notes from `Program data:` logs without
locking rent in per-note PDAs.
